[RDSC.9.3] The loader processes atoms in a single forward
pass and does not re-order atoms. `AlphaNode` / `BetaNode` / `TerminalNode`
atoms reference each other by `node_id` (globally unique per
bundle), so cross-module references resolve regardless of
stream position; emitting per-module groups in `module_id`
ascending order keeps a declaration ahead of its downstream
references.
